testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.debug.tickdebugger.service.TickStreamIngestionServiceTest

testcase.name: Strict v2 accepts old flat x/z/plane
snapshot failure aborts the receipt and produces no successful result
v2 real observations and GAPs preserve separate identities
v2 GAPs require a null capture identity and synthetic marker
Strict v2 rejects nested position without y or z
Invalid nested position does not create null flat aliases
Old flat x/z/plane synthesizes position.y
Strict v2 accepts flat worldX/worldY/plane
post-commit publication is registered only on the success path
Strict v2 accepts flat x/worldY/plane
Strict v2 rejects invalid plane
overlay failure rolls back all work
interleaved sources accept independent low sequences
Strict v2 rejects nested position without x
processTickBatch persists questHelper when present
processTickBatch allows missing questHelper
Strict v2 rejects a non-map position without escaping normalization
checksum mismatch is rejected before any persistence
wire identity fields must match the DTO before receipt lookup
v2 identity conflicts are permanent while exact retries are idempotent
Strict v2 accepts nested playerState.position.x/y/plane
same batch ID with a different checksum is rejected
Strict v2 rejects flat position with null x
packet tick validation rejects long overflow instead of accepting a wrapped distance
Strict v2 accepts and normalizes numeric string coordinates
packet retry with altered content fails as an identity conflict
Old flat HP/prayer/energy/animation are stored with synthesized nested fields
typed action checksum must match the Micro6 golden vector
packet retry with altered tick fails as an identity conflict
Strict v2 rejects flat position with non-numeric x
Strict v2 rejects nested position with boolean x
interleaved sources reject a duplicate hidden between other sources
delayed v2 GAP markers do not fail ordinary observation ordering
packet retry with identical content is idempotent
an exact duplicate returns the existing durable acknowledgment
Strict v2 rejects nested position with null x
same tick with a different batch ID is rejected
receipt boundary returns PERSISTED after a successful commit
Strict v2 rejects flat position with object worldX
log failure rolls back snapshot, receipt, actions and bounds
Strict v2 normalizes numeric string world coordinates
Strict v2 accepts nested position with x and z
